verdict.rationale: Ironclad's own evidence shows template-based contract creation: a No-Code Builder for creating contracts, Workflow Designer workflows launched from templates, and a hands-on user describing 'intelligent templatized form entry'. That supports the guided-questionnaire half of the story, but only through thin mentions. The only review-related evidence is general approval and signature policies; nothing shows the product flagging specific answers as needing attorney review. missing for 10: documented guided questionnaire/form logic that fills document clauses, any mechanism that flags choices for attorney review, evidence the generated documents are filled correctly, in-depth first-party docs on the builder, independent corroboration of the current product.
